caption: The drawing features two main objects on a plain, off-white background. At the top, there is a horizontal band displaying a decorative floral pattern. This pattern consists of two large red flowers, two smaller blue flowers with yellow centers, and multiple green leaves interspersed with black accents. Below this, there is a detailed, shaded drawing of a white ceramic mug with a handle on the right side. The mug is adorned with the same floral pattern seen above, encircling its body. The mug’s surface is shaded in light gray tones to suggest curvature and depth, and it has a distinct base and a decorative, slightly ornate handle. The artist’s signature and date, "I. M. Burge '38", appears in the lower right corner.
title: Shaving Mug
